svg.title: Higher Greeks describe different local sensitivities
svg.desc: Three separate calculated spot profiles, each with its own scale, for Gamma, Vanna and Vomma under generalized Black-Scholes-Merton with K=100, r=b=0.05, sigma=0.2 and T=1 year. Raw volatility units are used. The dotted vertical guide marks S=100. Inputs are hypothetical.
svg.text: Higher Greeks describe different local sensitivities
Hypothetical European Call · K = 100 · r = b = 5% · volatility = 20% · T = 1 year
Gamma: change in Delta per +1 spot unit
Vanna: change in Delta per +1.0 volatility
Vomma: change in raw Vega per +1.0 volatility
The vertical scales and units differ. Vanna and Vomma may change sign.
For one volatility percentage point, use Δvolatility = 0.01.
